messages.description: Branch delete dialog: prompt for deleting one remote branch
Branch delete: notice after one remote branch was deleted
Branch delete dialog: title when several branches are deleted at once (count is at least 2)
Branch delete dialog: what deleting the listed local branches does
Branch delete dialog: what deleting the listed remote branches does
Branch delete dialog: how many marked references are left out
Branch delete: notice after several branches were all deleted (count is at least 2)
Branch delete: notice when some of several branches could not be deleted, with the first failure
Branch menu: delete every branch marked in the log's branches pane
Repository name shown with branch deletion results and force confirmation
Notification action to open the outcomes of a branch deletion

en-US.desktop.branch.deleteRemotePrompt: Delete the remote branch '{name}'? It is deleted from the remote for everyone who uses it, and its remote-tracking branch is removed here.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteManyLocal: Only merged local branches are deleted. Unmerged branches require a separate force-delete confirmation.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteManyRemote: Remote branches are deleted from their remote for everyone who uses it.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteSkipped: Left out of the selection: {count}. Tags, HEAD and the current branch are not deleted here.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteRepositoryChanged: The selected repository changed. Start branch deletion again.
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteChanged: The branch changed after confirmation. Start deletion again to review its current state.
en-US.desktop.branch.unmergedPrompt: These local branches were kept because they are not fully merged. Review the warning before force deleting them.
en-US.desktop.branch.forceDeletePrompt: These local branches contain unmerged commits. Deleting them may leave commits without a branch reference and make them difficult to recover. Only the branches listed below will be deleted. Continue?
en-US.desktop.branch.deleteResultSummary: Deleted: {deleted}. Kept: {kept}. Failed branch names are red; hover for the reason.

zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteRemotePrompt: 删除远程分支“{name}”？它会从远程仓库中删除，所有使用这个仓库的人都将看不到它，本地对应的远程跟踪分支也会一并移除。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteManyLocal: 仅删除已合并的本地分支。尚未合并的分支需要另行确认强制删除。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteManyRemote: 远程分支会从远程仓库中删除，所有使用这个仓库的人都将看不到它们。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteSkipped: 所选项中有 {count} 项不会删除：标签、HEAD 和当前分支不在这里删除。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteManyFailed: {total} 个分支中有 {failed} 个删除失败。{name}：{reason}
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteRepositoryChanged: 所选仓库已变化，请重新开始删除分支。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteChanged: 分支在确认后已发生变化，请重新开始删除并确认当前状态。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.unmergedPrompt: 以下本地分支尚未完全合并，已保留。强制删除前，请先查看警告并再次确认。
zh-CN.desktop.branch.forceDeleteTitle: 确认强制删除这些分支？
zh-CN.desktop.branch.forceDeletePrompt: 这些本地分支包含尚未合并的提交。删除后，部分提交可能失去分支引用而难以恢复。仅删除下方列出的分支。是否继续？
zh-CN.desktop.branch.deleteResultSummary: 已删除 {deleted} 个，保留 {kept} 个。删除失败的分支名以红色显示，悬停可查看原因。
